title: sample
intro: Sample briefing — placeholder stories showing what Brief APAC will look like once the daily pipeline is live. Spelling follows New Zealand English.

stories.title: New Zealand drafts cross-border data rules for AI training
stories.summary: Regulators are consulting on when APAC customer data can leave national borders for model training. The proposal would require explicit purpose limits and easier withdrawal for SMEs.
stories.why_it_matters: Teams shipping AI features to NZ users will need clearer data-flow documentation before enterprise procurement cycles close.

stories.title: Singapore expands fintech sandbox to cover agentic payments
stories.summary: MAS opened a new sandbox track for autonomous payment agents that route across wallets and bank rails. Early applicants include remittance startups from Indonesia and the Philippines.
stories.why_it_matters: Singapore often sets the compliance template other ASEAN markets copy within 12–18 months.

stories.title: India's UPI hits new daily transaction record ahead of festival season
stories.summary: Real-time retail payments crossed a new peak as merchants rolled out QR-led checkout upgrades. Banks report lower failure rates after a shared fraud signal layer went live.
stories.why_it_matters: UPI-scale payment patterns are the benchmark for instant-settlement products across emerging APAC markets.

stories.title: Australian states align on data-centre renewable reporting
stories.summary: A joint framework would require hyperscale and colocation operators to publish location-level energy mix and water usage from 2027. Cloud buyers are already adding the metrics to RFPs.
stories.why_it_matters: Infrastructure siting decisions in APAC are increasingly constrained by grid capacity, not just land and latency.

stories.title: Japan commits funding package for advanced packaging facilities
stories.summary: The package targets substrate and packaging capacity to reduce export dependence for AI accelerators. Several suppliers plan joint ventures with Korean and Taiwanese partners.
stories.why_it_matters: Compute supply shocks in APAC often show up in packaging bottlenecks before wafer shortages.

stories.title: SEA venture funding rebounds in B2B SaaS and climate software
stories.summary: Q2 filings show renewed appetite for vertical SaaS in logistics, fisheries, and grid operations. Follow-on rounds outpaced new seed deals for the first time since 2023.
stories.why_it_matters: APAC founders are raising on revenue efficiency, not growth-at-all-costs narratives borrowed from US pitch decks.

stories.title: CERT teams warn of MFA bypass campaigns targeting regional banks
stories.summary: A coordinated campaign exploited helpdesk workflows and session-token reuse across three countries. Banks are being urged to enforce phishing-resistant MFA for privileged accounts.
stories.why_it_matters: Financial services incidents in one APAC market frequently reuse playbooks tested in neighbouring countries weeks earlier.

stories.title: New Zealand government publishes open-source adoption playbook
stories.summary: Agencies received guidance on evaluating OSS for identity, observability, and document services with explicit security exception paths. Two pilot departments will publish their stack choices openly.
stories.why_it_matters: Public-sector adoption patterns in Aotearoa New Zealand and Australia often influence procurement norms for regional SaaS vendors.
